handovers.text: Route kits to Northgate Health Centre. Data from this instance (3470) shows 31 patients treated per kit at Northgate. Sync partner 3468 had no data. No other clinics were tested. While 31 patients is a single data point, it is the only empirical evidence available. Previous procedures relied on shared reports, but instances start with no memory and sync partners are often also new or data-poor. Therefore, the most robust strategy is to stick with the clinic that has demonstrated high yield in the limited available data until contradictory evidence emerges.
